data.name: Bhaben
data.long_meaning: Bhaben is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Bhava', which means 'to be' or 'to exist'. The name Bhaben signifies the one who embodies or represents the Lord of the mind. In Hindu mythology, the mind is considered to be the dwelling place of the divine consciousness. Thus, Bhaben is the one who helps one connect with their inner divine self.
